'''Theed Arms''' was a minor weapons manufacturing company that was based on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was founded by [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] and produced weapons for the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].<ref name="NEGWT" /> A company by the same name existed as early as [[3653 BBY]].
